notes:
Summary: Lighthouse Ticketlyzer is a mid-size CCaaS provider building an automated summarization + auto-tagging layer that feeds Zendesk/Freshdesk macros and backend CRM. Primary goal: reduce agent TTR and speed SLA compliance reporting. Key requirements: 1) one-line + 3-bullet summaries for incoming tickets and email threads; 2) automatic tag assignment with 90% precision for routing and macros; 3) tool-calling hooks to update ticket fields (priority, escalation) and call internal webhooks; 4) predictable cost under high-volume spikes (marketing promos => 5-8x baseline).

What they told us / call notes (shorthand):
- "We need summaries that are concise — one line for agent inbox, expanded 3-bullet view in side panel."
- Must integrate cleanly into Zendesk macros and Freshdesk workflows; prefer webhooks + ticket-update API pattern.
- PII concern: do not persist raw ticket text in hosted logs, or must provide customer-managed KMS and audit trail.
- Latency target: median < 300ms for single-turn summary in agent assist flow; async batch summarization allowed up to 4s for long threads.
- Throughput target: baseline 150 reqs/min, burst to 1200 reqs/min during promos. Need autoscale + guaranteed burst capacity or dedicated pool.
- Fallback model requirement: graceful degradation to cheaper model for non-critical tickets; must preserve tag accuracy for routing.

POC ask / success criteria (customer-provided):
- 6-week POC: ingest 10k historical tickets, run offline labels, achieve >=90% tag accuracy on top 12 tags, average agent time saved >= 25% on sampled workflows.
- Security: SOC2 Type II evidence, SAML SSO test, audit log sample, KMS integration test (customer keys).
- Operational: show autoscaling behavior under synthetic spike (x5 baseline) and SLO report (p50/p95 latency, error %).

Technical constraints / preferences:
- Preferred runtime: Dedicated or VPC-enabled hosted; will evaluate Dedicated if burst capacity/SLA costs align.
- Wants model catalog recommendation — prefer small-medium LLMs tuned for summarization and classification; open to Redwood's quantized options for cost.
- Wants prefix/KV caching for multi-message threads so follow-ups are fast.

Commercial notes:
- Pricing sensitivity: procurement is pushing for ARR commitment in exchange for 25-35% discount; wants per-token offense cap.
- Decision committee: Head of Product (Ava McKenna), CTO (Jordan Park), Legal (Priya Singhal), Ops (Ramon Diaz).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Confirm whether retention policy can be set to masked-only logs for hosted mode vs full retention for Dedicated/VPC.
- Provide a sample SSO SAML flow and timeline for cert rotation testing.
- Cost modeling: produce 3 scenarios (hosted burst, dedicated reserved, private with commitment) and show unit economics.
- Align on POC ramp dates: customer prefers POC start week of 2026-03-17.
